faq_heading: Chilliwack houses under $1 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Chilliwack houses sell for under $1,000,000?
faq.a: 500 of 717, or 70%. A further 120 sold in the next range up, $1,000,000 to $1,199,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a house in Chilliwack?
faq.a: $879,900 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $1,000,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $740,000 and $1,050,000.

faq.q: Which Chilliwack area has the lowest house prices?
faq.a: Vedder Crossing, at $667,000 across 30 sales at $435 a square foot, median year built 2006. The highest of the 8 lowest was Sardis South at $895,000.

faq.q: How fast do Chilliwack houses sell?
faq.a: 25 days at the median, closing at 97.5% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,000,000).

In Chilliwack, 500 of the 717 houses (70%) sold under $1,000,000. The median was $879,900, with the middle half between $740,000 and $1,050,000. The busiest price range, $800,000 to $999,999, had 251 sales.

blocks.text: Which Chilliwack areas sell for less?

blocks.text: Where most Chilliwack house sales happen

blocks.text: What $1,000,000 buys in Chilliwack by property type

Against Chilliwack houses, where 70% of sales were under $1,000,000, condos had 99% under it (250 of 253 sales); houses with a legal suite had 11% under it (7 of 61 sales); coach and laneway houses had 25% under it (3 of 12 sales).

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,000,000 in Chilliwack

In Vedder Crossing the median house sold for $667,000 across 30 sales, $333,000 under $1,000,000. Across Chilliwack the median house took 25 days to sell and closed at 97.5% of the last list price, with 6% of the 717 sales above list. Check the roof age and foundation.
